info.title: Subako Public API
info.description:
The public HTTP interface to Subako.

Every request carries a bearer credential, and the organization it acts in is the credential's -- no path names one. Work resources belong to a workspace, named by the `Kikuvi-Workspace` header where a user credential cannot imply one.

Listings are cursor paged: pass the `next_cursor` a page returns back as `after`, and `order` decides which way the walk continues; pass its `prev_cursor` back as `before` to step back. Writes that create something accept an `Idempotency-Key`, and a retry under the same key returns the saved receipt rather than acting twice.

get.description:
The same log as a live tail, framed as server-sent events: one event per row, `id` the seq, `event` the wire `type`, and `data` the same `SessionEventBody` the paged read renders.

The stream stays open across idle stretches -- a keep-alive comment holds the connection while nothing happens -- so one connection spans a session's whole life rather than a single run. With no position named it starts at the live head, fixed before the response begins; a client that wants history pages the events route newest-first and deduplicates on seq against what the tail delivers.

With `deltas=true` the stream also carries `delta` frames: a model's output as it is produced, one `SessionDeltaBody` each, with no `id`. Deltas are never stored and may be lost; each previews one target until the event that ends it lands -- for a model call, the `message_assistant` with the same `model_call_id` -- or a `discard` frame says it never will. A reader joining mid-target first receives the frames that target sent so far.

SessionSandboxStatusBody.description:
Stable lifecycle vocabulary for v1. Adding or changing a value requires a
new API version; additional internal states map to these public states.

- `dormant`: no instance has been started; an exec provisions one.
- `provisioning`: an instance is starting, restoring, or resuming; exec waits.
- `running`: an instance is available for exec.
- `draining`: backup, suspension, or retirement is in progress; exec waits.
- `suspended`: an idle instance is paused; an exec resumes it. Archive deletion
  still returns 409 until automatic retirement.
- `archived`: the instance is retired; an exec provisions a new one and restores
  the last published archive, if present. Archive deletion is permitted.
- `failed`: the generation failed; a new exec attempts provisioning from the
  last published archive, if present. Archive deletion is permitted.

A published archive can be downloaded in any state. Status is a snapshot;
a concurrent exec or lifecycle transition can change whether deletion succeeds.

UpdateModelProviderBody.description:
An absent field leaves that part of the provider as it stands, so a
rename need not restate the endpoint -- nor the credential.

api_key.description:
A new upstream credential, sealed and put in place of the stored one.
Write-only: no route answers with a key, so there is nothing to read
back and nothing to compare against. The provider keeps its id, so
every agent version already naming it goes on resolving.

UpdateVaultBody.description:
An absent field leaves that part of the vault as it stands, so a rename
need not restate the metadata.

cost.description:
Hundred-millionths of a credit, as `balance`. Absent for a byok call
or a platform one nothing priced.

oneOf.description: The engine's time on one claim interval of the run.
A sandbox's time on one running interval.

Bytes held over one interval: a published workspace archive, or a
session tree's volume, billed to its root.
The worker's time on one function call.

grant.description: The grant the call went through, as the agent's config names it.

oneOf.description:
Bytes written to a session tree's volume, as billed: by a function
call, which `run_id`, `grant`, and `tool` name, or by an upload, which
leaves them absent.

UsageResourceBody.description: What an event measured; `kind` names the shape.

VaultBody.description:
A vault row. Carries no credential and no envelope: a vault is a
container, and what is in it is read through the credential route.

metadata.description: Whatever the caller stored alongside the vault.

VaultCreated.description: The id of the vault just created. Read it back for the rest of its row.

VersionPinBody.description: The latest version at resolution time, or an exact one.

VolumeAreaParam.description:
One of a volume's two areas: `tmp`, always there and cleared a day after the
tree's last activity, or `data`, kept until the root session is deleted where
the root agent enables it.

VolumeConfigBody.description: The roots the session tree's functions reach beyond `/volume/tmp`.

VolumeDataBody.description:
Whether the volume offers a persistent `/volume/data` root. `enabled`
mounts it for the session tree's functions.

modified.description: When the entry itself last changed, in UTC.

path.description: The entry's path in the area, e.g. `notes/a.txt`.

size.description: Bytes for a file; 0 for a directory or a symlink.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

truncated.description: True when another page follows, which `next_cursor` then starts.

path.description: The file's path in the area.

VolumeListDepthParam.description:
How far beneath its prefix a listing reads: `all` for every entry beneath
it, `children` for only those directly in it.

WorkspaceBody.description:
A workspace: the scope agents, sessions, vaults, skills, and keys
belong to.

WorkspaceMemberBody.description: One member of a workspace, with the role they hold in it.

WorkspaceRoleBody.description:
What a member may do in the workspace. An admin manages the workspace and
its membership; a member works in it.
